information:
![](https://www.kidsplus.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/logo_kidsplus_sticky.png)
This competition will be raising funds for the [Kids Plus Foundation ](https://www.kidsplus.org.au/)
50% of your registration fee will be donated to the Foundation to support treatment and interventions for babies, children and young people with cerebral palsy and similar neurological conditions.


![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
**Important notes:**
Please take the time to read the FAQ tab, even if you have previously competed. To ensure this is a COVID-safe environment, things will be done differently and there will be additional conditions in place.

Please note there is a **strict** density limit at the venue and competitors may only bring **ONE** guest.

If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
